assets.description: Native coin of the KRIPTON blockchain. Fixed total supply of 10,000,000 KPT, no inflation.
assets.extended_description: KRIPTON (KPT) is an independent Cosmos SDK Layer 1 blockchain (chain-id kripton-1) built with CometBFT. KPT has a fixed total supply of 10,000,000, all created at genesis; there is no inflation and no further minting. Validators and delegators are rewarded from transaction fees only, and 2% of fees go to the community pool. KPT is the fee and staking token of the chain. It can be transferred to Osmosis over IBC and traded there. Blocks and transactions can be checked with the public block explorer at https://kripton.live/explorer/.
